import re, sys, pathlib
PILLS = {"app-pill", "app-fancy-pill", "app-status-pill"}
OLD, NEW = "disableTooltip", "hideHint"

def fix_template(t):
    out = []; i = 0; refs = set()
    while True:
        m = re.compile(r"<([a-zA-Z][\w-]*)").search(t, i)
        if not m:
            out.append(t[i:]); break
        out.append(t[i:m.end()]); j = m.end(); name = m.group(1)
        # scan tag to '>' respecting quotes
        k = j; q = None
        while k < len(t):
            c = t[k]
            if q:
                if c == q: q = None
            elif c in "\"'": q = c
            elif c == ">": break
            k += 1
        tag = t[j:k]
        if name in PILLS:
            # rename attribute names outside quotes
            parts = re.split(r"(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')", tag)
            for p in range(0, len(parts), 2):
                parts[p] = re.sub(r"(?<=[\s\[])disableTooltip(?=\]|[\s=/]|$)", NEW, parts[p])
            tag = "".join(parts)
            refs.update(re.findall(r"#(\w+)", tag))
        out.append(tag); i = k
    t = "".join(out)
    for r in refs:
        t = re.sub(r"\b%s\.disableTooltip\(\)" % r, r + "." + NEW + "()", t)
    return t

PILL_SIGNALS = r"(?:this\.(?:firstPill|fancy|pills)\(\)\??|\bpill|\bfancy)"
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    p = pathlib.Path(f); s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"); o = s
    if f.endswith(".html"):
        s = fix_template(s)
    else:
        s = re.sub(r"(template:\s*`)(.*?)(`)", lambda m: m.group(1)+fix_template(m.group(2))+m.group(3), s, flags=re.S)
        s = re.sub(PILL_SIGNALS + r"\.disableTooltip\(\)", lambda m: m.group(0).replace(OLD, NEW), s)
    if s != o:
        p.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8", newline=""); print("changed", f)
EOF
